latest.title: PSP Alpha 1 Preview — PPSSPP v1.20.4
latest.summary: Experimental PPSSPP v1.20.4/libretro integration in the isolated :psp process, with native 1x resolution and frame skipping disabled. The published initial preview has a known PSP ROM discovery/import issue. A correction adds an explicit Import as → PSP selector and bounded recursive PSP folder scanning; CI and physical-device validation are still pending.
